_doc: S-FLIGHT-1 (TA-30) spike-only parameters. Not a content def: nothing here ships. Game values (ship, flight_common, projectile, weapon, rules, pad radius) come from the real defs (content/defs, or the canonical fixture copies in this folder until GD-02 lands ships/projectiles/weapons). Every block cites its source; values marked 'spike' are tuning hooks this spike introduces and reports in docs/spikes/TA-30/REPORT.md.

arena._doc: Pad at 40 N, 22.5 E (start slot 0 longitude, R0 B.6) so the sun (Noon Pole, +Z) stands 40 degrees high. Ship spawns docked on the pad.

targets._doc: 03 s14.6: straight-line gun with targets at 200-800 m including co-altitude targets; task card: hit 5 targets, bomb 2 ground targets. Air targets are placed by bearing (deg from north) and great-circle distance (m) from the pad at an altitude above datum. hp: spike (one 1 s burst of gun_dart at 10 rounds/s x 6-14 kills one). Ground targets take bombs (bomb damage 400 vs structures).

landing._doc: Auto-dock assist = 05 s5.5 landing phases L4-L6 (TRANSITION, HOVER-DESCENT, FLARE) and position law: kp_pos 0.35, kd_pos 1.1, kp_vz 1.2, max_tilt_deg 30, flare_agl_m 8, touch_vz_mps 2.0, sink = clamp(0.25 * agl, 1.5, 6.0), nose within 45 deg of up leaves TRANSITION, L4->L5 at horizontal speed < 15 m/s within 30 m, flare tilt 10 deg. Spike hooks: transition_max_tilt_deg (L4 may tilt the thrust axis further back to kill speed), latch_release_mult (assist stays engaged while DOCK is held until distance > mult x auto_dock_radius_m), att_kp/att_kd (attitude loop of track_thrust_vector), launch_guard_s, attempt_radius_m (telemetry: contact within this distance of the pad counts as a landing attempt), scrape_hp (03 s6.1: 5 HP), pad_crash_damage (03 s6.4: 100), tilt_damage_deg (03 s6.4 / 06 s6.4: attitude damage band 25-45 deg; not yet a flight_common field), pad_contact_margin_m (03 s6.4 'altitude above the pad surface <= bounding_radius + 0.5'), contact_release_m (spike: a ground-contact episode ends once the ship is this far above the ground, so a bouncing slide scrapes once), grade bands and q weights (03 s6.4).

approach._doc: Harness-only autopilot for the automated landing measurement: 05 s5.5 L1 TRANSIT / L2 APPROACH reduced to a glide slope h(d) = d tan(glide_deg) with speed schedule s(d) = s_min + (v_cruise - s_min)(d - transition)/(gate - transition); gate 1200 m, glide 8 deg, transition 250 m, s_min 40 m/s (05 L2). cruise_alt_agl_m: 05 flight params (spike value). Gains of the path loop: spike.

assist._doc: 06 s3.6 assist math. Auto-level: delay 0.25 s, roll = -phi/30 deg, pitch = clamp(-0.05 v_n - (theta - theta_trim)/30 deg, -0.6, 0.6), theta_trim 4 deg. Aim assist FULL: cone 6 deg, k 0.4, range 800 m, 0.5 s hold-over. Auto-throttle: band 15 m/s, brake when 25 m/s over. Spike hook: auto_level_max_pitch_deg (auto-level stays off while the nose is above this pitch, so it does not fight a tail-down hover; reported to 06).

input._doc: 06 s2.4 (class detection) and s3.5 (flight mapping math). Mouse aim 0.12 deg/px, aim pitch clamp 85 deg, pitch full at 15 deg, yaw full at 10 deg, roll full at 40 deg, bank-to-aim above 8 deg. KBM power key ramps 4/s; lever steps 0.25. Dead zones 0.12 touch / 0.15 gamepad, gamma 1.6 / 1.8, trigger dead zone 0.05, LT brake > 0.5, yaw bumper ramp 0.15 s. ARCADE: bank 70 deg, roll full at 35 deg, pull 0.6 above 45 deg bank, yaw 0.3. Flick-up FLIP: 80 du in 0.2 s, 600 du/s. Class switch: axis > 0.35, mouse > 4 du. Touch layout positions and sizes (du) from 06 s4.3.

camera._doc: 06 s5.2 Chase: D0 35 m (Dart chase_distance_m), H = 0.2 D, stretch 0.15 to v_dive, crit-damp omega 12 rad/s, tau_dir 0.08 s, tau_roll 0.25 s, k_roll 0.35, roll clamp 30 deg, look-ahead 0.25 above 20 m/s, FOV 70 deg (+6 boost), clearance 2.5 m. Spike hook: hover view (06 lever, reported): above hover_pitch_lo..hi deg of nose pitch the look direction blends to the belly-side horizontal with hover_depression_deg down, so a tail-down hover is watched from behind and above, not from under the ship.

render._doc: Spike presentation: flat-shaded icosphere at subdivision level 6 (81,920 faces, ~98 m edges at R; chord sag < 0.25 m), per-face colour jitter, decorative boulders near the pad (no collision; the Terrain stub is the datum sphere). max_fps 60 per 03 s13 MEDIUM; render interpolation of the 30 Hz sim (03 s10.1). Bomb predictor: 03 s14.6 (ballistic integration for 6 s) at 06 s6.3's 15 Hz. ground_marker_agl_m: spike height cue (ring under the ship and a drop line) below this AGL.

telemetry._doc: Telemetry CSV in user:// (03 s14.6 lists user://flight_log.jsonl; the TA-30 brief asks for CSV). aoa sample every 1 s while cruising level: speed >= 0.7 v_cruise, |v_n| <= 3 m/s, |pitch rate| <= 10 deg/s, nose below 30 deg.

harness._doc: Headless measurement runs (harness/sf_harness.gd). Seeds fixed for replay.
